objective: Let the D1 migration workflow repair one skipped migration without replaying later ones. Add scripts/runner/select-migrations.mjs exporting selectMigrations(names, { from, through }): both are four-digit prefixes, through is optional, only files named NNNN_name.sql qualify, results are sorted ascending, an inverted range, invalid prefix or empty selection throws. Running the file as a script reads FROM_MIGRATION and THROUGH_MIGRATION from the environment, lists apps/web/drizzle, and prints the selected paths space-separated as drizzle/<name>. Wire it into .github/workflows/migrate-d1.yml with a through_migration input. scripts/runner/select-migrations.test.mjs must pass.
